name: Alice
source:
Alice is a small rabbit who fell into a magical tree hole and turned into a girl.
Originally, she was a baby rabbit around 2 months old, living on a farm.
She loves sweet fruits and carrots the most.
After restoring the colors of Wonderland, She now lives with the White Rabbit, and they have promised to protect each other forever.
